sources.snippet: Overview HyperCLOVA X SEED 14B Think is a next-generation language model that moves beyond the conventional approach of simply increasing model size to improve performance. It combines HyperCLOVA X's lightweighting technology for building high-efficiency LLMs with advanced reasoning capabilities.
